title: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 模型扩层（Depth Up-Scaling）

standard.summary: 训练加载时把 Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 的 blocks（TI2V-5B 原生 30） 交错复制扩到更多层数，三条残差支路的输出投影全部归零：attn1.to_out[0]（门控自注意）、attn2.to_out[0]（无门控交叉注意）、ffn.net[2]（门控 FFN），均含 bias，使新增层以恒等残差初始化，得到一个更深的可训练底座。仅支持全参微调（wan22-finetune）。
standard.effect: 模型按 wan22_depth_expansion_target_layers 重建为更深结构，初始行为与原模型一致（新层输出归零）；训练范围由 wan22_depth_expansion_train_scope 控制；保存的产物是完整扩层底座。仅支持 TI2V-5B 单塔；T2V-A14B 双塔需保持两塔深度一致且与 sigma 分段路由耦合，扩层直接拒绝。
standard.whenToUse: 想以较低成本扩大模型容量（Depth Up-Scaling 路线）、在原模型能力基础上继续拉伸上限时；准备做扩层后长期微调的项目。
standard.avoidWhen: LoRA 训练不支持；显存与磁盘按扩层后的层数计费，请先评估资源；从扩层 checkpoint 恢复训练时必须保持相同的扩层配置（层数不匹配后端会明确报错）。

standard_en.summary: At load time, interleaves copies of Wan2.2 TI2V-5B's blocks (30 natively in TI2V-5B) up to a larger count, zeroing the output projections of all three residual branches: attn1.to_out[0] (gated self-attention), attn2.to_out[0] (ungated cross-attention) and ffn.net[2] (the gated FFN), bias included, so each new layer starts as an identity residual. The result is a deeper trainable base. Full finetune only (wan22-finetune).
standard_en.effect: The model is rebuilt into a deeper structure according to wan22_depth_expansion_target_layers, with initial behaviour identical to the original model (the new layers output zero); the training scope is controlled by wan22_depth_expansion_train_scope; the saved output is the complete expanded base. Only the single-tower TI2V-5B is supported; the dual-tower T2V-A14B has to keep both towers at the same depth and is coupled to sigma-segment routing, so expansion is refused outright.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to enlarge model capacity relatively cheaply (the Depth Up-Scaling route) and stretch the ceiling on top of the original model's ability; for a project that intends a long finetune after expansion.
standard_en.avoidWhen: LoRA training is not supported; VRAM and disk are charged by the post-expansion layer count, so assess your resources first; when resuming training from an expanded checkpoint the same expansion configuration has to be kept (the backend reports a clear error if the layer counts do not match).

advanced.principle: Depth Up-Scaling（如 SOLAR 的做法）：交错复制已有 transformer 层构造更深网络，把新层的输出投影零初始化使残差路径退化为恒等，保证扩层瞬间模型输出不变，训练从「无损起点」开始学习新增容量。
advanced.intervention: wan22/wan22_depth_expansion_runtime.py：加载时执行交错复制与零投影，并把扩层元数据写入 adapter manifest；trainer_resume_runtime.py：LoRA 挂载扩层底座时按 manifest 校验层数（不匹配失败关闭）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 参数量与显存按层数比例上升；扩层容量需要足够数据与步数才能兑现为质量收益。
advanced.tradeoffs: 产物是完整底座（体积大，非 LoRA）；扩层模型的推理成本永久上升；训练范围选 all 时成本最高、选 new_layers 最接近标准 DUS 配方。

advanced_en.principle: Depth Up-Scaling (as in SOLAR): interleaved copying of existing transformer layers builds a deeper network, with the new layers' output projections zero-initialized so the residual path degenerates to identity, guaranteeing the model's output is unchanged the instant of expansion; training then learns the added capacity from a "lossless starting point".
advanced_en.intervention: wan22/wan22_depth_expansion_runtime.py: at load time performs interleaved copying and zeroed projections, writing expansion metadata into the adapter manifest; trainer_resume_runtime.py: when a LoRA mounts on an expanded base, layer counts are validated against the manifest (mismatch fails closed).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Parameters and VRAM rise proportionally to layer count; the expanded capacity needs enough data and steps to materialize as quality gains.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The artifact is a full base model (large, not a LoRA); the expanded model's inference cost rises permanently; with train scope all the cost is highest, and new_layers is closest to the standard DUS recipe.
